Description (chapters included)

Doctor Doom didn't build Doomsday on his own. The Avengers helped. A LOT. 😬

We counted down the 12 biggest Avengers mistakes that set up Avengers: Doomsday, from a bracelet nobody asked about to the Captain who just... stayed in the past. Doom has been keeping a thank-you list. It's very long.

This is DumDown: Marvel, dumbed down, so anyone can get it. A funny cartoon countdown for Marvel fans of all ages, perfect before Doomsday hits cinemas.
